div.div: شَمُّورٌ , occurring in a trad. respecting 'Ooj Ibn- 'Unuk, [or Ibn-'Ook,] as meaning something with which a mass of rock was hollowed out according to the size of his head, (TA,) Diamond: (K:) thought by El-Khattábee to have this meaning; but he says, “ I have not heard respecting it anything upon which I place reliance. ” (IAth, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
